description: Register a webhook URL to receive notifications when actual recorded spend (from record_usage) crosses a USD threshold within a rolling window. Optionally scope to a specific org_id (omit for total spend across all orgs). Fires at most once per period_days while spend stays over threshold. Returns the alert ID.

org_id.description: Organisation to monitor. Omit for total spend across all orgs.

period_days.description: Rolling look-back window for the spend check, in days (default: 30)

threshold_usd.description: Spend level in USD that triggers the alert

url.description: Webhook URL to POST when the alert fires

name: register_budget_alert
